node.title: Perl launching process
node.author: pwagyi
node.doctext: Greeting monks! I have been using perl system, backtick for some time to invoke other executables. But then I came across IPC::Cmd run, run_forked, I realize that it's somewhat better in a sense that I can easily access stdout, stderr and also exit code. So the question is when is it appropriate to use each system, backtick, or other modules? Is there best practice?
